definition: Defines the account to or from which a securities entry is made and the usage type.

IssuanceAccount.name: Issuance Account
IssuanceAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

IssuanceBlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Issuance Block Chain Address Or Wallet
IssuanceBlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: issuance blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

PrimaryAccountIndicator.name: Primary Account Indicator
PrimaryAccountIndicator.definition: Defines if the related issuance account is the primary account or not.

IssuanceAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule.definition: If IssuanceAccount is present, IssuanceBlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

IssuanceAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule.definition: If IssuanceBlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, IssuanceAccount must be absent.

SecuritiesAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rul.definition: Either IssuanceAccount or IssuanceBlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
